sample_size_basis.metric: minimum two-real-coordinate Mahalanobis resolution across reconstructed X/Y rows
sample_size_basis.choice: 80k keeps the primary degree<=3 mixed gate in the resolved regime; degree4 is a joint heldout score rather than an individual-row discovery gate

observable.name: C4-covariant-gauge neutral projective-leg pair G_r(a,b)
observable.covariance: all 328 coordinates from the same 400 fresh random batches

rank_gate.shared: paired complex x/y eigenvalues across four hand-charge channels
rank_gate.minimal_rule: first rank whose mixed commuting gate and degree4 heldout both have p>=0.01

algebra_gate.commutator: axis-fitted commuting joint realization must predict xy,x2y,xy2
algebra_gate.Ty_equals_RTxRinv: x/y characteristic-polynomial equality is scored as a necessary gauge-invariant condition
algebra_gate.R4: exact realified channel map has order four and signed C4 orbit residual is scored
algebra_gate.D5: not identifiable because the neutral pair cancels simultaneous deck phase

reveal_order: C4 orbit and characteristic necessary scores
claim_boundary: Do not force rank two; rank greater than three remains a valid result.
The commuting model is tested by mixed moments not used in the axis fit.
A passing characteristic score does not uniquely identify latent R up to its centralizer.
No deck generator is inferred from this neutral pair stream.
